publication_checks.scope: Exact extracted pure transport classes, .NET 10, C# 5; includes known limitation and expected-defect cases, not acceptance certification

known_limits: Entry ids include unappended UI timer stamps.
Normal deadline and post-stop exclusions are outside the drop count, including callbacks stamped before the deadline and admitted later.
Header size is not bounded by MaxBytes; oversized configuration text can overrun it.
Zero local drops does not establish provider or exchange completeness.
